title: The Law Association of Zambia v The Speaker of the National Assembly [2025] ZMCC 24 (28 November 2025)
case_name: The Law Association of Zambia v The Speaker of the National Assembly
issue_tags: legal representation of the Speaker of the National Assembly
Article 122 — duty of public officers to protect Judiciary
misjoinder/joinder under Order V rule 4 Constitutional Court Rules
Law Association of Zambia v President [2019] ZMCC 13 — followed
outcome_detail: Notice of Motion seeking an order directing independent legal representation for the Speaker of the National Assembly under Article 128 dismissed; the Court affirmed its earlier decision in Law Association of Zambia v President (2019/CCZ/0013) that the Attorney General is the proper legal representative of all arms of Government including the Legislature (paragraph [66]). The Court further ordered joinder of the Attorney General as Respondent in place of the Speaker by misjoinder under Order V rule 4 of the Constitutional Court Rules (paragraph [67]). No order as to costs.
